questions.question: Where was David when he prayed Psalm 142?
What does David say about his refuge?
options: He has more than friends enough to keep him safe from all harm
No one cares for his soul; the LORD is his refuge and portion
His many mighty men will surely deliver him from every danger
His own strong right hand has already won for him a sure escape
questions.answer: No one cares for his soul; the LORD is his refuge and portion

questions.question: David asks God to bring him out of prison so he may give thanks to God's name.
With my voice I cry out to the LORD; with my voice I plead for _____.
I say, 'You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the _____.'
